parabola_fit_g — DRIVE kendama op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.parabola_fit_g(t, P, *, g: 'float' = 9.81, t_ref: 'float' = None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import kendama; kendama.parabola_fit_g(t, P, *, g: 'float' = 9.81, t_ref: 'float' = None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("parabola_fit_g"))

Usage

Fits the parabola p(t) = p_r + v_r (t − t_ref) − ½ g (t − t_ref)² ẑ by least squares with gravity g (−z) known (6 unknowns = position and velocity).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

t (N,)、P (N, 3)(NaN の行は飛ばす)。t_ref 既定 = 使った最後の時刻(= その瞬間の状態を返す)。各軸は [1, t − t_ref] の線形最小二乗(z は ½ g (t − t_ref)² を足してから)。返り値 {"p", "v", "t_ref", "rms" (残差の RMS [m]), "n"}。有効な点が 2 未満・時刻が全部同じ・g ≤ 0 は ValueError。真空の正確な標本なら (p, v) を丸め誤差で戻す(門)。
